• Avere la disponibilità per i tempi di distribuzione flessibili
• sono in buone condizioni fisiche

descriptionByLocale.en:
• Specialist surgical storage 100%, as of 1 September 2026 or by agreement Apply now In our Institute of Anesthesia & Intensive Care Medicine we look after patients who are being operated on in the Hospital Limmattal, are seriously ill, have suffered an accident or need intensive care. Together with anesthesia care, our team performs more than 7,500 sedations, general and regional anesthesias every year. In the interdisciplinary intensive care unit, we look after around 1,000 patients per year. The treatment of pain patients is also part of our range of services. The dossier of recruiters is not considered. Here they engage
• Reception and care of patients
• in preparation for the upcoming operation
• when taking over shift management
• responsible for the correct and operation-specific storage of patients
• when operating the image intensifiers and medical devices
• in the installation of plaster casts and immobilisation materials
• When working in 3-shift operation
• when re-establishing the operating tables and storage aids
• have completed vocational training as specialists OP - storage
• ideally already have several years of experience as surgical warehousing manager
• Have the readiness for flexible deployment times
• are in good physical condition
• Have a good knowledge of medical terminology
• are a resilient, flexible and team-oriented personality with a high level of customer orientation
• Have very good knowledge of German in word and writing
• Have an adept use of MS Office and Clinic Information Systems
• Reduced employee parking spaces
• Motorcycle parking, lockable bicycle parking
• With the ZVV Bonus Pass / Z-Bonus Pass we offer an attractive public transport subscription for employees
